notes: Deliberately flat/neutral orography for the exposed 35 m Sennen sea-cliff (wind_mvn sennen enablement, 2026-06-12). The west-Penwith clifftop has open Atlantic fetch through the dominant W/SW/NW sectors and no upwind terrain worth modelling at NWP-cell scale, so every DEM-derived term is zeroed rather than estimated: terrain_gradient_dx/dy=0 makes oro_uplift and oro_uplift_x_q identically zero, and the zero upwind_gain tables make oro_upwind_gain zero — only oro_wind_sin/cos carry signal, preserving the 29-feature wind recipe's column contract. Non-zero scalars are the trivially defensible ones: site elevation 35 m from config.yaml, NWP cell elevation ~0 m (the cell is mostly sea), window_sea_pct ~60 (rough estimate, unused by the wind models). No climatology_by_sector_month block: only the 4a terrain/synoptic builder reads it and 4a is not enabled for sennen_cove. Replace this file with a real DEM run (the bonehill_rocks.json pipeline) if precip/4a-style phases ever onboard Sennen.
